text:
Assuming this means wound-closure strips like Steri-Strips rather than hanging strips, don't pull them off: let them fall away on their own, usually within 7 to 10 days. If they're still on after about two weeks, moisten them with water or petroleum jelly, then peel them gently toward the wound's centre, parallel to the skin, one at a time. See a clinician if the wound reopens or shows signs of infection.

CONFIDENCE: 85
